claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows faint stains on the seat cushion, and the witness describes a single long seat cushion forming what looks like a 3-seater bench-style sofa, not a clearly defined 2-seater.
Both photos show a cream/beige upholstered sofa with curved back and armrest.

risks.risk: Actual number of seats/length not confirmed (2-seater vs 3-seater bench)
risks.proof: Full-length photo with a tape measure or a person standing beside it for scale
risks.if_unproven: priced as ambiguous size, assume smaller/cheaper 2-seater configuration until measurement confirms otherwise

risks.risk: Hidden stains, odors, or tears not visible in the two photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each cushion and armrest in bright light, plus a verbal/video confirmation of smell
risks.if_unproven: priced as stained/used condition, not 'very neat'

risks.risk: Frame material and structural integrity (wood vs cheap particle board, wobble, broken springs)
risks.proof: Photo of underside/frame joints and a short video of someone sitting on it
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown frame quality, worst-case low durability

risks.proof: Video of someone pressing or sitting on the cushions
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn/soft foam, lower comfort grade

risks.risk: Age and usage history (pets, smoking, prior repairs)
risks.proof: Seller statement with supporting close-up photos of wear points (arms, back corners)
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, no age discount applied

risks.risk: Possible reused/stock photo (watermark suggests listing reposted from Jiji)
risks.proof: A fresh photo with today's date or a handwritten note visible in frame
risks.if_unproven: priced cautiously as unverified listing, risk of stale or misrepresented item

proof_requests: Full-length photo with a tape measure or person for scale to confirm 2-seater vs 3-seater
Close-up shots of all stains, tears, and armrest stitching under good light
Photo of the frame underside and joints
Short video of someone sitting on the sofa to show cushion support and stability
A fresh photo with current date/newspaper to confirm listing is current and not reused
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a sofa, so it can be priced at worst case given visible stains and an unconfirmed seat count, pending measurement and condition proof.
